channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: Phone driver who was unaware he killed cyclist jailed for nine years – after previously avoiding driving ban for phone use due to “risk of hardship”
item.description: Van driver Matthew Marston was found to have been on his phone for a “significant amount” of time before killing cyclist Aran Potkin, who should have been visible for up to 200 metres thanks to his hi-vis clothing and lights

item.title: Crankbrothers Stamp Trail Lace Flat Shoes
item.description: Flat-pedal footwear with off-road riding pedigree – but with comfort and durability for more casual riding 7/10

item.title: Cyclists told to "stick to cycle lanes" filled with parked cars; Premier Tech joins Alpecin as new co-title sponsor; Cycling coverage won’t change as Netflix set to take over Warner Bros Discovery + more on the live blog
item.description: It's Friday! Megan Huws is back with today's cycling news and views

item.title: Ducati has its sights set on cycling dominance as it partners with Diamant for all new 2026 range
item.description: Legendary motorcycle brand collaborates with Diamant to introduce a new e-MTB, road and gravel bike range

item.title: “Who are you punishing? An 11-year-old out with his mum?” Cyclists say “anti-bike rhetoric” behind sabotage on popular New Zealand trails, putting hundreds of children at risk – but residents claim riders are “causing others harm”
item.description: “Putting these traps up creates fear and anger. Nothing good will come of it other than regret, injury, and legal implications,” one local mountain biker said, while a residents’ group has called for dedicated walkers-only tracks

item.title: Cinelli's new HoBootleg Geo is a modern expedition rider's dream
item.description: Steel-framed, mountain bike-inspired geometry, and a gazillion mounting points. Is the new HoBootleg Geo a bikepacker's dream?

item.title: WIN! A Merida Big.Trail 300 (size medium) with upgrades from HUNT, Kenda, Funn and Elite worth over £1,900 in our huge Christmas giveaway!
item.description: A bike is the ultimate Christmas present, right? So we've built one up for a lucky reader to win!

item.title: “What did we have to do with it? We were a cycling team”: Israel-Premier Tech “lost out for political reasons”, claims sports director, after Palestine protests which painted riders and staff as “indecent”
item.description: “Finally, we’re out of the political turmoil and back to talking about cycling, which is what we wanted,” NSN Cycling DS Francesco Frassi said

item.title: ‘Ow much? Tadej Pogačar’s Tour de France-winning Colnago Y1Rs fetches staggering $190,500 at auction – over $170,000 above estimate
item.description: For those UAE Team Emirates enthusiasts slightly more stumped for cash this Christmas, a bike gently ridden by Pogačar’s teammate Joāo Almeida also sold for a much more palatable $21,590

item.title: “Nothing to share”: Warner Bros. Discovery tight-lipped on future of cycling and sport subscription fees after Netflix takeover and loss of Champions League football confirmed
item.description: WBD did reveal, however, that the Winter Olympics will be made available on all subscription tiers, including its basic £3.99 a month plan, and without the need to subscribe to TNT Sports
